correctness.rationale: For m>=2,d>=3 and 1<=r<=m, essential variable count equals rank of first derivative catalecticant: annihilating directional derivatives are precisely the eliminated variable directions. A 1-PS with variable weights B^i (B>d) gives distinct monomial weights by base-B digits. Monomial fixed points of essential rank exactly s are degree-d monomials on exactly s active variables, counted C(m,s)C(d-1,s-1). C-star Euler localization and subtraction yield claimed cumulative and exact χ_c values; when r>d, the fixed point contribution is 0 but Fermat sums x_1^d+...+x_r^d prove nonempty strata. At r=m, Vandermonde identity recovers ambient binomial C(m+d-1,d). Independently counted compositions and supports for 30 degree/dimension pairs with 2<=m<=7, 3<=d<=7; the combinatorial counting proof covers all dimensions.
